entries.title: Isaiah 25:1
segments: ¶O LORD, You [are] my God. I will exalt You, I will praise Your name, For You have done wonderful [things; Your] counsels of old [are] faithfulness [and] truth.

entries.title: Isaiah 25:2
segments: For You have made a city a ruin, A fortified city a ruin, A palace of foreigners to be a city no more; It will never be rebuilt.

entries.title: Isaiah 25:3
segments: Therefore the strong people will glorify You; The city of the terrible nations will fear You.

entries.title: Isaiah 25:4
segments: For You have been a strength to the poor, A strength to the needy in his distress, A refuge from the storm, A shade from the heat; For the blast of the terrible ones [is] as a storm [against] the wall.

entries.title: Isaiah 25:5
segments: You will reduce the noise of aliens, As heat in a dry place; [As] heat in the shadow of a cloud, The song of the terrible ones will be diminished.

entries.title: Isaiah 25:6
segments: ¶And in this mountain The LORD of hosts will make for all people A feast of choice pieces, A feast of wines on the lees, Of fat things full of marrow, Of well-refined wines on the lees.

entries.title: Isaiah 25:7
segments: And He will destroy on this mountain The surface of the covering cast over all people, And the veil that is spread over all nations.

entries.title: Isaiah 25:8
segments: He will swallow up death forever, And the Lord GOD will wipe away tears from all faces; The rebuke of His people He will take away from all the earth; For the LORD has spoken.

entries.title: Isaiah 25:9
segments: ¶And it will be said in that day: "Behold, this [is] our God; We have waited for Him, and He will save us. This [is] the LORD; We have waited for Him; We will be glad and rejoice in His salvation."

entries.title: Isaiah 25:10
segments: For on this mountain the hand of the LORD will rest, And Moab shall be trampled down under Him, As straw is trampled down for the refuse heap.

entries.title: Isaiah 25:11
segments: And He will spread out His hands in their midst As a swimmer reaches out to swim, And He will bring down their pride Together with the trickery of their hands.

entries.title: Isaiah 25:12
segments: The fortress of the high fort of your walls He will bring down, lay low, [And] bring to the ground, down to the dust.
